question: What should the Shape slot's tip say when you rest the pointer on it?
context: In Design, the tool bar's Shape slot now starts on the Rectangle as the UI mock draws it. The mock's tip says Shape (R); the app's tip names the shape the slot holds, Rectangle R.

options.label: Tip names the shape: Rectangle R
options.summary: The tip says the shape the slot is wearing right now, Rectangle R, Ellipse O or Line L, the same way every family slot in the bar already does. The mock words Shape (R) are not shown.
pros: Matches Photoshop, whose tips name the tool the slot holds
Tells you which shape a click will draw
Same rule as the Selection and Crop slots
cons: Differs from the mock words Shape (R)
options.mitigation: Press and hold still lists the whole family by name.

options.label: Tip says Shape R, as in the mock
options.summary: The tip reads Shape R whichever shape the slot is wearing, exactly the mock words. The slot icon still shows which shape a click draws.
cons: The tip no longer tells you which shape you get
The shapes slot reads unlike the other family slots
options.mitigation: The icon on the slot changes with the shape.
